# TableOfContents

A navigation list of the sections of a text, with the current one marked.

```tsx
import { TableOfContents } from '@kafka-ds/react'
```

## When to use it

- For texts with three or more sections, beside or above the article.

## When not to

- For a short text: headings are enough.
- To navigate between pages: use the navigation of the site.

## Examples

### With a current section

Pass `activeId` to mark a section yourself. Without it, the component watches the headings while the reader scrolls.

```tsx
<div className="max-w-xs">
  <TableOfContents items={items} activeId="toc-metodo" />
  <Prose className="sr-only">
    <h2 id="toc-intro">Introducción</h2>
    <h2 id="toc-metodo">El método</h2>
    <h3 id="toc-ejercicios">Ejercicios</h3>
    <h2 id="toc-cierre">Cierre</h2>
  </Prose>
</div>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` (required) | `TocItem[]` |  |  |
| `title` | `string` |  | Heading above the list. Defaults to the localised "On this page". |
| `activeId` | `string` |  | Id of the section that is current. When omitted, the component watches the headings as the reader scrolls. |
| …rest | `HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>` | | Everything else is passed to the underlying element. |

## Accessibility

- **Landmark:** a `nav` named by its title, with an ordered list of links to `#id`.
- **Current section:** `aria-current="location"` plus a gold marker and bold text (not colour alone). Follows the headings while scrolling, or is controlled with `activeId`.
- **Targets:** each link is at least 44 px tall.
- **Order:** the same as the headings, so the keyboard order matches the visual order.

## Content

- Use the heading text, shortened if needed.
- Two levels at most.
